app.name: CouchPad
app.tagline: Gaming from the comfort of your couch
recovery.help: Automation is paused until recovery is complete. Retrying recovery will reopen CouchPad.
recovery.retry_help: Starts the separate rescue; CouchPad reopens after recovery.
recovery.failed: Recovery could not be completed. Check your display and audio connections before trying again.
countdown.help: Choose how long to wait when the controller connects and disconnects.
automation.help: Turn on to react when the controller connects.
display.target_hint: Select the TV and the internal monitor; restart CouchPad to apply.
display.targets_error: Could not list displays. Check the connection and try again.
automation.setup_required: Select the TV, a different monitor, and the TV audio output to set up automation.
automation.setup_restart: Exit CouchPad from the notification area and reopen it to apply the selected devices.
automation.setup_unavailable: The recovery component is unavailable. Reinstall CouchPad to set up automation.
update.check: Check for new versions on GitHub
gamepad.simulated_help: Local simulation: no real controller is used.
combo.change_reason: Available when button capture is active.
settings.startup_error: Windows startup could not be updated.
settings.start_with_windows_help: Creates a per-user task; CouchPad opens at logon.
settings.minimize_to_tray_help: When you close the window, CouchPad stays in the tray.
audio.restart_help: Select the output used by the chosen display mode and restart after changing these options.
settings.allow_display_writes_help: Advanced: enables CCD and the recovery watchdog. Restart after changing; use only with the TV connected.
settings.real_gamepad_help: Uses XInput to detect controllers. Restart CouchPad after changing this option.
settings.help: Applied only when automation is on.
audio.restore_help: On exit, the previous output and volume are restored, even if changed during the session.
launchers.failed: Could not start or close the launcher. Display and audio can still be restored.
language.label: Language
about.title: About CouchPad
about.description: Turn on your controller to play on the TV. CouchPad switches the display and audio and can open Steam or Hydra in Big Picture. Turn off your controller to restore your previous display and audio.
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.subtitle: Every state, without touching hardware.
